activity_summary: You read the letter on the table. It asks for shoes for all three children in one month, says your father's cough is cheerful, and asks whether you mean to come at Lent or only to say so. You did not write under it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the three things and left the sheet open.

entities.name: Henley Street
entities.context: Mentioned in Three things, and no date
